import.lead: From finding the vehicle to seeing it arrive in Costa Rica, we are with you every step of the way.

import.whatsapp: Hi, I'd like a quote to import a vehicle.

process.intro: JOOX does more than find the vehicle: we coordinate the whole process until it is ready to leave customs in Costa Rica.

steps.title: You contact us
steps.body: Tell us which vehicle you are looking for, or which one you already found in the US. We talk about make, model, year, colour, budget and features.

steps.title: We search and compare options
steps.body: We show you the platforms and sources we work with and go through the options together by make and model, year, colour, condition, price, location and related costs. You see the options before you decide.

steps.title: We choose the vehicle and make the offer
steps.body: When you find one you like, we arrange the offer or purchase with the dealer or seller. You know the price and terms before going ahead.

steps.title: Vehicle purchased
steps.body: Once the offer is accepted or the vehicle is bought, the import formally begins. Payments to the auction, the seller or the dealer are arranged, depending on how it was bought.

steps.title: Overland transport
steps.body: Once paid, we book the tow truck from the vehicle's location to the port. Our reference manual lets us estimate this cost by distance before arranging the move.

steps.title: Shipping to Costa Rica
steps.body: At the port we arrange the sea freight, which is priced by the vehicle's size and features. Then it sails for Costa Rica.

steps.title: Unloading and bonded warehouse
steps.body: When it reaches Costa Rica, the vehicle is unloaded and moved to the warehouse the shipping line assigns.

steps.title: DEKRA inspection
steps.body: At the warehouse, the vehicle goes through the DEKRA inspection needed to continue with its registration in Costa Rica.

steps.title: Tax assessment
steps.body: After the inspection comes the tax assessment, based on the official table that sets the vehicle's value.

steps.title: Tax payment
steps.body: With the assessment done, the taxes are paid and the vehicle waits for approval to continue.

steps.title: Storage and release authorisation
steps.body: Storage fees can build up while the process is completed, and are paid as they apply.

steps.title: Approval and release: the big day
steps.body: With every approval and payment complete, the vehicle is released and heads to its final destination.

about.lead: JOOX CARS is a car rental, sales and import company in Guápiles, Costa Rica. We also source spare parts from Japan, China, Europe and the US.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To provide complete automotive solutions that make it easier to buy, import, sell and rent vehicles, and to find and import spare parts, standing by our customers at every stage with advice, transparency and support.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To be a leading automotive solutions company, connecting Costa Rica with the international vehicle and parts market, known for our reliability, transparency and excellent service, building lasting relationships and sustainable growth.

dna.title: JOOX DNA
dna.body: We are a bridge between our customers and the international car market. We look for solutions, make processes easier and stand by our customers from start to finish, working with transparency, trust and commitment to turn every automotive need into a concrete solution.

what.title: What we do
what.lead: We connect people with the automotive solutions they need. At JOOX we rent and sell vehicles, find and import vehicles from the US, and source spare parts from different platforms and suppliers.
what.close: Whether you are looking for a vehicle, want to import one you found yourself or need a specific part, we are with you through the whole process.

meaning.title: What JOOX means
meaning.body: JOOX stands for movement, global connection and complete automotive solutions. The letters “OO” are wheels in endless motion, continuity and trust: a service that stays with the customer at every stage, from buying to parts and rental.
